description.zh-TW: 彌勒佛通常以布袋和尚的形象出現，大肚能容，笑口常開。
description.en: Maitreya is often depicted as the Cloth Sack Monk (Budai), with a big belly representing tolerance and a broad smile symbolizing joy.

story.zh-TW: 彌勒佛是未來佛，釋迦牟尼佛的繼任者，目前在兜率天內院說法。
story.en: Maitreya is the Future Buddha, the successor to Shakyamuni Buddha, currently preaching in the Tushita Heaven.

name.zh-TW: 新竹彌勒大道大自然文化世界

deityStory.zh-TW: 擁有全世界最高的彌勒佛銅像，園區宏偉，宣揚熱愛大自然與世界一家的理念。
deityStory.en: Features the world's tallest bronze Maitreya Buddha statue. The magnificent park promotes the love of nature and the concept of one global family.

description.zh-TW: 藥師佛發願治癒眾生身心病苦，手持藥缽或藥草。
description.en: Medicine Buddha vowed to heal the physical and mental sufferings of all beings, often holding a medicine bowl or herbs.

story.zh-TW: 藥師佛發十二大願，願消除一切眾生的病痛與災難，使人健康長壽。
story.en: Medicine Buddha made twelve great vows to eliminate all sickness and disasters for sentient beings, granting them health and longevity.

deityStory.zh-TW: 雖以文殊為名，但定期舉辦藥師法會，信眾虔誠祈求健康。
deityStory.en: Although named after Manjusri, the temple regularly holds Medicine Buddha ceremonies where worshippers pray for health.

domain.en: Guidance to the Western Pure Land

description.zh-TW: 阿彌陀佛是西方極樂世界的教主，念其名號可往生淨土。
description.en: Amitabha Buddha is the lord of the Western Pure Land. Reciting his name leads to rebirth in the Pure Land.

story.zh-TW: 發四十八大願，建立莊嚴的西方極樂世界，接引念佛眾生。
story.en: Made forty-eight great vows to establish the magnificent Western Pure Land to receive all who recite his name.

deityStory.zh-TW: 台灣最大的佛教道場之一，大雄寶殿主祀釋迦牟尼佛，但阿彌陀佛信仰也是其核心，設有淨土洞窟。
deityStory.en: One of Taiwan's largest Buddhist monasteries. While the main hall enshrines Shakyamuni, Amitabha worship is central, featuring a Pure Land Cave.

description.zh-TW: 韋馱菩薩是佛教的護法神，身穿甲冑，手持金剛杵。
description.en: Skanda is a dharma protector in Buddhism, wearing armor and holding a vajra staff.

story.zh-TW: 相傳佛陀涅槃後，邪魔搶走佛牙，韋馱奮起直追奪回，故被封為護法神。
story.en: Legend says after the Buddha's nirvana, demons stole his tooth relic. Skanda chased them down and retrieved it, becoming a guardian deity.

deityStory.zh-TW: 中台禪寺殿堂雄偉，韋馱菩薩像威儀嚴肅，守護著這座現代化的佛教建築。
deityStory.en: The monastery is majestic, and the statue of Skanda stands solemnly guarding this modern Buddhist architectural work.

description.zh-TW: 伽藍菩薩即三國名將關羽，在佛教中被尊為護法神。
description.en: Sangharama Bodhisattva is the famous general Guan Yu from the Three Kingdoms period, revered as a guardian deity in Buddhism.

story.zh-TW: 傳說關羽死後魂魄在玉泉山顯聖，受智者大師點化，發願護持佛法。
story.en: Legend says Guan Yu's spirit appeared at Yuquan Mountain after death. After being enlightened by Master Zhiyi, he vowed to protect the Dharma.

deityStory.zh-TW: 雖然是道教宮廟，但關帝君（伽藍菩薩）信仰跨越儒釋道，行天宮的清淨莊嚴也帶有佛教色彩。
deityStory.en: Although a Taoist temple, the worship of Guan Yu (Sangharama) spans Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism. Xingtian Temple's solemnity reflects Buddhist influences.
